newsitem.title: UK: Frogmore to buy properties for 92.2 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Frogmore to buy properties for 92.2 mln stg.

text.p: British property investment and development company Frogmore Estates Plc said on Tuesday it was buying 109 properties for 92.2 million stg from Axa Equity & Law Life Assurance Society Plc.
Frogmore said the properties currently generated an annual income of nine million stg.
Frogmore said it intended to retain nine properties from the portfolio as investments and dispose the remaining properties over the next two years.
Frogmore said it had decided to finance 25 million stg out of the consideration by placing 4.58 million new shares. The balance will be financed through bank facilities.
The new shares will represent about 8.9 percent of Frogmore's issued share capital. S.G. Warburg is acting as broker and underwriter to placement.

Commenting on the acquisition, Frogmore's chairman Dennis Cope said: "The acquisition presents us with the opportunity of acquiring a significant portfolio of commercial properties offering an attractive initial yield".
